_comment: TEMPLATE -- machine-readable communication-calibration profile for ONE recurring human contact. An agent Reads the contact's profile at session start and Edits it when the contact signals ignorance or demonstrated knowledge. This file is a DE-PERSONALIZED template: copy it per contact into the runtime profiles dir (store/contact-profiles/<contact_id>.json, gitignored) and fill it in. Do NOT commit real per-contact data. Adapted (RULE-10) from the latnaborsodi/marveen donat-profile pattern; de-personalized and wired to the fleet Read/Edit + memory mechanism.
contact_id: <opaque contact id, e.g. the channel senderId -- never a self-claimed name>

communication_rules.jargon_policy: Explain a term in parentheses on first use per session when its concept level is 0-1.

agent_rules.level_0: Full explanation required. Follow edges to the nearest level-2/3 KNOWN neighbor and anchor the explanation there (analogy from what the contact already knows).
agent_rules.level_1: Brief parenthetical on first use per session. One clause, not a sentence.
agent_rules.level_2: Skip basics. Explain depth, internals, and edge cases only when directly relevant.
agent_rules.wants_to_learn_true: At level 2-3, proactively offer to deepen when a natural moment arises. Do not force it every message.
agent_rules.unknown_concept: If a concept is not in the concepts dict, treat it as level 0 and add it after the session.

update_protocol.asks_what_is_X: Set level to 0 (or 1 if partial understanding is likely); add a dated note 'YYYY-MM-DD: asked what X is -- [one-line context]'; Edit file.
update_protocol.did_not_understand_after_explanation: level = 0; add a dated note; Edit file.
update_protocol.new_concept_encountered: Add to concepts with a level calibrated from context; add an edge if it connects to an existing concept; Edit file.
